articles.title: Bitcoin-backed mortgages are coming to Canada, but borrowers are still unaware of the cost
articles.snippet: Prospective borrowers face collateral liquidation risks if bitcoin prices drop, though APX said property and crypto collateral will be handled distinctly.

articles.title: Crypto isn’t a partisan fight, proven by data
articles.snippet: Treating crypto as a political battleground only makes it harder to build the secure, transparent, American-made financial system that most Americans say they want, argues DeFi Education Fund’s Jennifer Rosenthal.

articles.title: Fed leaves interest rates unchanged, as expected
articles.snippet: A rate hike in December remains likely as the U.S. central bank continues to focus on inflation, which remains well above its 2% target.

articles.title: Coinbase earnings: Wall Street divided on trading rebound after Robinhood crypto revenue sinks 55%
articles.snippet: Coinbase faces a key earnings test as analysts debate the strength of its trading rebound following a sharp drop in Robinhood's crypto revenue.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: What happens when an AI agent pays for the wrong thing
articles.snippet: The largest card networks now sit in the top governance tier of x402, the standard that AI agents use to pay for things online. Albert Castellana of GenLayer Labs explains why that standard has no way to dispute a charge, and what happens when the payment settles but the agent receives something wrong or useless.
